goal: Create the React/Vite/TypeScript project, set up global design tokens, and render the static desktop shell.
summary: Phase 1 completed after grader feedback: scaffolded React + TypeScript + Vite project with Tailwind CSS v4; created Tahoe theme tokens, ThemeProvider, and CSS variables; built Wallpaper, MenuBar, Desktop, and ContextMenu shell components. Added Vitest + Testing Library with 14 passing tests covering tokens, ThemeProvider dark-class toggle, MenuBar rendering and click handlers, and ContextMenu escape/edge-clamping behavior. Fixed ContextMenu to clamp to viewport using measured size with fallback defaults for jsdom. Verified with npm run build, npm test, and a headless Chrome screenshot showing the desktop shell.
stepSummaries:
1. Scaffold project with Vite + React + TypeScript and configure Tailwind CSS. [verified]
  2. Create global theme tokens (colors, shadows, radii, spacing) matching Tahoe's light/dark palette. [verified]
  3. Build desktop shell components: Wallpaper, MenuBar, Desktop area, and right-click context menu. [verified]
